title: Evaluation session
evalNone: No evaluation has been saved for this CV and job revision yet.
draftBody: Draft from the exact CV and job revisions shown above.
noDocs: No documents have been prepared for this session yet.
reviseHint: Describe what should change. A new document revision will be created.
noProvider: The AI gateway is not configured. Set it in Settings before starting a run.
letterAsk: Draft a cover letter for this job.
messageAsk: Draft a short application message for this job.
readOnly: Messages from this unpaired session are read-only.
unpairedBody: This older session has no stored CV and job revision pair. Its history is read-only; start a paired session to evaluate or prepare documents.
outdated: A newer CV revision is available
outdatedBody: This session stays bound to its original CV revision. Start a new session to use the latest CV with the same job revision.
redraftBody: A new draft will be added to this document. Earlier revisions stay in its history.
historyEmpty: No earlier runs are recorded for this session.
evaluateHelp: The evaluation is an assessment aid, not a hiring prediction.

list.subtitle: Each evaluation compares one CV version with one job posting version.
list.emptyBody: Pick a saved job and one of your CVs. The agent reads the posting, compares it with your CV, and returns an AI fit score from 1 to 5, the skills it found and a written report.

delete.title: Delete the evaluation “{{title}}”?
delete.body: It disappears from this list. Documents the agent made stay in Documents. Agent work history stays in Agent activity.
delete.busy: The agent is still working on this evaluation. Wait for it to finish or stop it first.

result.title: Evaluation result
result.notPrediction: An AI estimate to check against the evidence. Not a hiring prediction.
result.keyword: Matched by keywords from the posting, no AI.
result.relatedNone: No documents yet. Prepare documents in the next tab and they appear here.

empty.title: Evaluate this job against your CV
empty.body: The agent reads the job posting and compares it with your CV. It does not change your CV or contact anyone.
gets: An AI fit score from 1 to 5 with a short explanation
The skills from the posting that it found in your CV
A written report you can copy

panel.title: Agent workflow

hints.evaluate_job: Your CV is compared with the job posting.
hints.tailor_cv: Suggests CV edits backed by your experience.
hints.draft_documents: Drafts a cover letter or message.
hints.apply_prepare: Answers the questions on the application.

panel.reviewHint: Reviewing opens the proposed changes. Nothing is applied to your CV until you choose.
